$themes.$description: The surface every www.framer.com public page paints: the dark palette the body-declared --token-<uuid> colour styles resolve to. No light variant or theme toggle exists on the marketing site. /community/gallery is a separate community stack, also dark; /login is the light auth shell, whose readings are the auth set.
